summary.text: Lorena Betts is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 16th Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Karla Miller in a race with no incumbent.
A community organizer, she won the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary over Corey Robinson.

paragraphs.text: Betts earned a high school diploma from Escola Rosa Frigger Piovezan in Brazil and attended Southern New Hampshire University, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her career experience as community organizing.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Betts described herself as a mother, civic educator and community organizer in Lowell and North Chelmsford, and said she led No Kings rallies in Chelmsford.

She listed her key messages as affordable housing, including expanded down payment assistance for first-time homebuyers; an economy that works for working families, including holding utility companies such as National Grid accountable; and transparency on Beacon Hill, including an audit of state spending.
She said she would hold regular town halls and office hours.
